features.text: Specialized dorsal night splint design provides optimal stretch to relieve morning heel pain and arch discomfort while maintaining comfort during sleep
Unique hinged shell technology allows precise angle adjustments to target specific areas of foot pain and ensure proper therapeutic positioning
Fully adjustable tension strapping system delivers customized compression and support throughout the night
Integrated skid-resistant sole enhances safety during nighttime bathroom visits and prevents unwanted movement during sleep
Breathable, lightweight construction ensures comfortable wear throughout the night without overheating
